search_text: published ZDI-19-574 ZDI-CAN-8686 Electronic Arts Origin URI Handler Remote Command Execution Vulnerability 2019-06-17 CVE-2019-12828 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2019-12828 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Electronic Arts'] ['Origin'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Electronic Arts Origin. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. There is an issue with the way the product handles URIs within certain schemes. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user at medium integrity. title: Electronic Arts Origin URI Handler Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Electronic Arts Origin. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. There is an issue with the way the product handles URIs within certain schemes. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user at medium integrity.
